purpose: Check initial menu configuration when phase2 FPGA logic is absent, before any factory-flash change.
constraints: Separate immutable operator and fresh lease/source/USB/UART/clock/identity admission.
Extend the selected-image gate explicitly for the exact phase1 RBF; reject other RBFs and preserve vendor/forced-scan checks.
Use the programmer documented volatile p;file.rbf operation, never a JIC/flash operation.
Read-only recovery admission of current FIT, staged files and three installed records.
Automatic native startup with no fesboot, initial menu load from SD, both installed-core launch/return cycles and final Park.
Unchanged per-phase bounds, first failure terminal, independent cleanup and retained trace.
separate_flash_requirements: Identify actual flash part and geometry independently of the vendor recipe.
Create and verify a complete factory-flash backup and concrete rollback procedure.
Audit the backup path: stock recovery enables CONFIG_SPI_FLASH_UNLOCK_ALL; do not assume sf probe is read-only.
Programmer R means ERASE; any readback design must use the documented Examine operation and verify its supported device/helper behavior.
Obtain explicit approval for the final reviewed factory-flash change, then run an independent power-on test.
